# Nevada License Defense

> Nevada License Defense (nevadalicensedefense.com) is the professional license defense practice of Craig K. Perry & Associates, a Las Vegas law firm. Attorney Craig K. Perry has practiced law in Nevada for more than 31 years (37 years of trial practice) and has defended nurses and medical professionals before Nevada licensing boards for over 14 years — hundreds of board cases, many resolved by dismissal. ## What we handle

Board investigations and Notices of Investigation, written responses to complaints, informal conferences, formal disciplinary hearings under the Nevada Administrative Procedure Act (NRS Chapter 233B), settlement and consent agreements, probation and monitoring, license reinstatement, license application denials, and criminal matters that affect a professional license.

## Licensing boards (with governing Nevada statute)

- [Nevada State Board of Nursing — NRS Chapter 632](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/nursing): RNs, LPNs, APRNs, CNAs
- [Nevada State Board of Pharmacy — NRS Chapter 639](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/pharmacy): pharmacists, pharmaceutical technicians, dispensing practitioners
- [Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners — NRS Chapter 630](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/medical): MDs, physician assistants
- [Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine — NRS Chapter 633](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/osteopathic): DOs
- [Nevada State Board of Dental Examiners — NRS Chapter 631](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/dental): dentists, dental hygienists
- [Chiropractic Physicians' Board of Nevada — NRS Chapter 634](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/chiropractic)
- [Nevada State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners — NRS Chapter 638](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/veterinary)
- [Nevada Physical Therapy Board — NRS Chapter 640](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/physical-therapy): PTs, PTAs
- [Nevada Board of Occupational Therapy — NRS Chapter 640A](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/occupational-therapy): OTs, OTAs
- [Nevada Board of Psychological Examiners — NRS Chapter 641](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/psychology)
- [Board of Examiners for Marriage and Family Therapists and Clinical Professional Counselors — NRS Chapter 641A](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/marriage-family-therapy)
- [Nevada Board of Examiners for Social Workers — NRS Chapter 641B](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/social-work)
- [Respiratory care practitioners (Board of Medical Examiners) — NRS Chapter 630](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/respiratory)
- [Radiologic technologists — ARRT ethics matters](https://nevadalicensedefense.com/radiology)

## Key guidance

- Do not respond to a licensing board, investigator, or complaint before speaking with a license defense attorney; statements can be used against the licensee.
- An investigation usually does not suspend a license by itself, but boards can seek emergency (summary) suspension in serious cases.
- A malpractice insurer's attorney defends the civil case; the license often needs separate counsel.
